text: I'm a foster carer, I've had this little boy (3) a couple of weeks. I think his nappy has been dry all day. I've checked and I'm fairly sure he hasn't had a wet one since this morning, so 12 hours or maybe more. I'm not sure if I'm counting right but I'm scared. He's also got a pink eye with sticky gunk in the corner. There's no rash on him at all, I looked everywhere. Please tell me what to do
